entities.summary: Avraham Aviv Alush is an Israeli actor, musician, model, and television host. He is best known for playing Amos Dahari "The Baker" in the Israeli series Beauty and the Baker, and as Jesus in the American film The Shack (2017). He also played a leading role in the Israeli series Valley of Tears (2020).
